sources.entry: python-docx - Creates, reads, and updates Microsoft Word (.docx) files.

summary.one_liner: python-docx is a Python library for reading, creating, and updating Microsoft Word 2007+ (.docx) files.
summary.what_it_does: The library lets Python code create a new Word document, add paragraphs, save it to a .docx file, and reopen an existing .docx file to read its contents. The README's example shows adding a paragraph to a new Document, saving it, then loading the file and reading the text of its first paragraph. The README names only these basic operations (create, read, update) and points to external documentation for more detail. It is installed with pip.
use_cases: update an existing Word document programmatically
notable: Simple Document API: add_paragraph, save, and paragraphs[].text
caveats: The README covers only basic usage and defers to external documentation for the full feature set
Targets .docx format only, as named in the README
